text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks a lot for today too! Well then, 
Trainer! I'll take my leave here!"
choice_data_list:
You're in quite a hurry. Got somewhere to 
be?

You're in quite a hurry. Got somewhere to 
be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, a little bit! I'll be like this for 
a while... Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One day, after those days continued, I 
went out into town. Even the familiar 
streets were decorated with illuminations, 
bustling with a full Christmas 
atmosphere."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking along and browsing the 
display windows... my feet came to a stop 
in front of a sporting goods store.
choice_data_list: (A golf glove...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Huh, you've never been winter golfing?
choice_data_list: You looked cold, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, what a waste! It's empty, so you can 
take your time and look around 
comfortably! Why don't we go together 
sometime?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Christmas is coming up, so maybe I could 
get a gift to thank them for inviting me. 
I'm not sure when I'll be able to give it 
to them, though...
choice_data_list: ...If it's just buying them, then...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Phew, ran my heart out...! Thank you so 
much!
choice_data_list: Well then, take care.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, wait, Trainer! ...Um, do you have some 
time after this today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer spoke up out of nowhere. I 
fully expected us to be heading out on 
errands today too, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm working a short-term 
part-time job at an amusement park. The 
Christmas event there is super nice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"The illuminations are pretty, and the 
stalls are cute too! ...So, whaddya 
think?"
choice_data_list: If I may, I'd love to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...! Of cooourse! I'll show you around, so 
leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
How was the glühwein? The one here is 
non-alcoholic, so everyone from kids to 
adults can enjoy it. It's really popular.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Some folks just aren't big fans of the 
smell of cinnamon, though...
choice_data_list: Delicious! It's warming me right up...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's one of my favorites too. Hehe, great 
minds think alike~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Let's strike this pose and take a 
photo together!
choice_data_list: L-Like... this, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Looking good! Alright, look at that 
smartphone over there~! 3, 2, 1... 
Alright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~! It's time for my part-time job! 
Trainer, that's it for the tour, but why 
don't you stop by where I work too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer was working at a restaurant 
inside the amusement park. Accompanied by 
a piano playing Christmas songs, her light 
footsteps joined in as she served the 
food.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting, here are the turkey 
legs and winter holiday drinks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When I told them I was the dedicated 
trainer, the shop manager gave me a little 
extra bonus! Keep it a secret, okay?
choice_data_list: Is that really okay? Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll let them know. Well then, take 
your time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I had satisfied my appetite and 
caught my breath... Mejiro Palmer tiptoed 
over, cautiously checking to see how I was 
doing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I'm on break now, got a 
second?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
A special delivery from Palmer the 
Reindeer♪ —Open it up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I opened the gift bag I received. Inside 
was a golf glove from a famous brand.
choice_data_list: This is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Remember when we talked about going 
golfing? Here are some winter gloves so 
your hands won't get numb.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Merry Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, I felt like everything 
fell into place. Why she hurried off after 
training. Why she seemed so busy all 
along—
choice_data_list:
About those errands I've had until now... 
I mean, that part-time job...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, spelling everything out is in 
poor taste, you know?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding my tongue, I search inside my bag. 
If I'm ever going to give the present I've 
been holding onto, it has to be right now.
choice_data_list: ...Actually, I have one of these too...
...Actually, I have one of these too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "...A bag? Wait, does that mean...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...! These gloves, are they...
choice_data_list: I'm so looking forward to golf!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...So... hehe. You were thinking the same 
thing, huh?
choice_data_list: Like a mutual surprise?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's it! We both succeeded, so there's 
no way we can't go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Allow this reindeer to escort you to your 
destination— Santa, who brought me such a 
wonderful present."
choice_data_list: ...I'm counting on you!
...Please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it's a promise. ...Oh, let's try 
putting on the gloves right away!
choice_data_list: I'll try putting it on, too.
Let me try it on too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... a perfect fit. Aren't we kind of 
amazing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...We might really be completely in sync! 
Even more than Santa and his reindeer!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, it's a deal! Oh, I know! Let's 
put on the gloves and take a commemorative 
photo.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Try putting it on, Trainer. And then do 
that pose from before... Yeah, okay, 
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Later, a photo showing one of each of 
their hands was sent on LANE. Every time I 
looked at it, a gentle warmth filled my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that looks great on you. How does it 
feel? Are your hands cold?
choice_data_list: It has a gentle, soothing warmth.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. I poured my heart into it, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Man, what clear skies! Let's get right to 
it, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Despite the biting winter chill, our 
hands never froze up... and we were able 
to enjoy golf to our hearts' content."

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Palmer-chan! Oh, looks like it 
was a success? Congrats~!

text_block_list.name: Store Staff B
text_block_list.text:
I worked so hard at my part-time job just 
for this! Man, I'm so glad it paid off...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Shh... keep it a secret, please.
choice_data_list: ...Thank you, truly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: "...No, yeah. You're welcome."

text_block_list.name: Store Staff A
text_block_list.text:
That's awesome, Palmer-chan! It all paid 
off in the end~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, "follow you"...!? I get it! It's 
fine! You don't have to say it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She must have tried her best in her 
own way to give me this gift. I decided I 
would cherish and take good care of these 
gloves."
